1.0.0.title: Harbor 1.0.0
1.0.0.intro: Harbor 1.0.0 is here, happy to have you guys aboard.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Music pairs with Spotify.
The Library opens your private TorBox cloud.
Anime sync lands every episode on the right cour.
PublicMetaDB joins as a tracker.
The player gains chapter navigation.
Media Servers gain collections, custom refresh times, and your server's own posters.
The new installer lets you pick what gets installed.
Trackers stop signing you out.
Playback survives audio device changes and episode switches.
Live streams stay live when you switch sources.
Media server libraries stop shrinking.
Episode ratings return.
The Mac launch crash is gone.

sections.heading: Music — Spotify
items: Connect Spotify with a pairing code.
Choose Harbor's player or your own Spotify app.
The quality badge shows what Spotify is playing.
Visualizers and meters move with what you hear.
They no longer follow the volume slider.
Audio settings are one click from the music page.

sections.heading: Music — Playlists and menus
items: Pin playlists to Home.
Open them from the pinned row.
Edit playlist details in a dialog.
Works for Harbor and Spotify playlists.
Right-click tracks, playlists, albums and artists for quick actions.
Jump back in, Made for you and recents get the same menus.
The add-to-playlist picker is a cover grid.

sections.heading: Manga
items: Arrange extensions like the plugins tab.
Search keeps your order.

sections.heading: Library
items: New: browse your private TorBox cloud.
Play files straight from it.

sections.heading: Anime and sync
items: AniList and MAL rewatches now sync.
A Count rewatches toggle controls them.
AniList custom lists and private entries appear in your library.
Episode titles and descriptions pick the best source per language.
Anime title language is now a general setting.
New option: prefer IMDb ids.

sections.heading: PublicMetaDB
items: PublicMetaDB is now supported.
Connect with your username and API key.
PMDB watchlists show on overview pages and in the Library.
Your PMDB watched history can feed Home's hide-watched.
Badges appear on Continue Watching cards.
Resume progress syncs as you watch.

sections.heading: Media servers
items: Browse your server's collections.
Pick refresh intervals from minutes to weeks, or Daily.
Server posters come first, with TMDB as a fallback.
Bigger sync pages fetch in parallel.
The "titles need review" banner can be dismissed.

sections.heading: Player and trailers
items: Chapter navigation in the desktop player.
Chapter markers on the timeline.
The chapters control can be hidden, moved or reordered.
Trailer autoplay is more reliable in hero views.
Autoplay can use its own resolution.
Failing trailers try alternative sources.

sections.heading: Details
items: Episode search looks across TMDB seasons.

sections.heading: Home
items: The featured hero can hide watched titles and backfill the row.

sections.heading: Installer and updates
items: Meet Harbor Shipyard, the refreshed installer.
Pick optional components: extension support and the game engine.
Pick optional tabs: Music, eBook and Manga.
Everything is on by default.
Harbor honors your choices everywhere.
Hidden tabs stay hidden; links do nothing.
Updates and repairs keep your setup.
Settings → Updates & backup → Modify installation changes it later.

sections.heading: Music fixes
items: Context menus fit their longest option.
Next and previous stay on the collapsed player bar.
Reloading rejoins stream or Spotify where you left off.
Resume lands on the right track even if the queue changed.
Restarting no longer wipes your save point.
Queued tracks start sooner.
Long playlists keep their scroll position past 100 songs.

sections.heading: Playback fixes
items: A/B loops land exactly where you mark them.
The seek bar hover preview no longer sticks.
Audio device or window changes no longer interrupt playback.
Audio stays in sync when the device list churns.
Output reloads wait for the device list to settle.
A reload can't hijack a new episode or rewind a seek.
The audio normalizer resyncs after a reload.
Live streams stay live after an in-place source switch.
Indexed video files stay in VOD mode.
Playback does less background work.

sections.heading: Manga fixes
items: The chapter list remembers your source filter.
It defaults to the source that owns the title.
Favorites and list entries re-resolve when sources change.
A stale entry never opens the wrong title.
Color-edition tags are stripped from titles.
Tracking and Discord presence stay accurate.

sections.heading: Library fixes
items: Bookmarks survive playback progress writes.
Offline progress still reaches the queue.
Single-video TorBox downloads show the playing spinner.
Repeat clicks no longer re-request the link.
The cast panel no longer overwrites your library tab.

sections.heading: Anime fixes
items: Sync and Continue Watching land on the cour that aired the episode.
Split franchises resolve to the right cour.
Simkl scrobbles the entry that owns the episode.
Simkl no longer shows S2E6 as S1E6.
Queued Simkl watches retry on their own.
A first-watch finale no longer counts as a rewatch.
The rewatch guard survives restarts.
Unaired sequel episodes no longer borrow other seasons' data.
Undated episodes are no longer marked TBA or stripped of art.
Missing episode titles fill in from MAL and Kitsu.
Episode titles keep your chosen language, even through provider fallbacks.
Continue Watching labels episodes as S# E#.
Black Clover opens the TV series, not its 2016 special.
The calendar drops duplicate franchise rows.
The calendar includes locally watched anime.
Anime4K verifies and repairs its shader pack.
Known anime open without the series-view flash.
Episode lists replace stale placeholders with aired data.
Continue Watching recovers old mappings and retries failed lists.
Resume lands on the right season.

sections.heading: Details fixes
items: Episode search no longer gets stuck on "Loading episodes...".
Episode search matches the titles shown in your language.
Returning from an episode keeps the season you were on.

sections.heading: PublicMetaDB fixes
items: PMDB reconnects after a restart.
Progress reaches PMDB before the player closes.
Completed watches clear their resume point.
PMDB maps anime episodes correctly.

sections.heading: Media server fixes
items: A short page no longer truncates or sweeps your library.
Custom intervals now fire on time.
The grid and posters paint progressively, without flicker.
Posters stay loaded across Collections and scrolling.
Open collections stay filled after a sync.
Quality labels show correctly.
Connecting is more reliable, and failures explain themselves.
A misconfigured proxy can no longer hijack server requests.
Big Picture filters no longer empty the tab.
The review banner counts correctly.

sections.heading: Home fixes
items: Watched movies and shows stay apart in the hero.
The hero falls back to its cache instead of vanishing.

sections.heading: Letterboxd fixes
items: Friends' review links no longer open source-check windows.

sections.heading: Discord presence fixes
items: Manga shows a real cover, even from local or extension sources.
Music presence updates instantly.
No duplicate track credits.
Presence fades a few seconds after pause (Privacy setting).
Continue Watching cards name the episode.
Timestamps stay correct when you seek.
Anime presence uses your preferred title.
Presence links point at Harbor's address.

sections.heading: Ratings and details fixes
items: IMDb scores agree everywhere.
The hero and the cards always match.
Episode ratings are back for every series.
Harbor's own ratings rank above OMDb.

sections.heading: Search fixes
items: AIOMetadata results survive catalog merges.
Search keeps your place when you come back.

sections.heading: Add-on, plugin and subtitle fixes
items: Addon setup pages fall back to your browser.
Retired TorBox and Stremio Local Files addons are no longer queried.
TorBox still works through the API.
Plugin episode links no longer carry stray season/episode tags.
User-installed local addons can serve subtitles.
Local trust now requires a truly local address.
Long translation offers are no longer dropped.
Auto-loaded subtitles no longer override the embedded preference.
Manual Off wins over late-loading translations.

sections.heading: Tracker fixes
items: Trakt tokens refresh properly, so you stay connected.
Simkl and Trakt only sign out on a true token rejection.
Sessions load at startup on any build or profile.
A fresh login is saved immediately.
Simkl and Trakt share one session across profiles.
MAL and AniList keep per-profile sessions.

sections.heading: Backup fixes
items: On Linux, .harbx restore uses the normal file picker.

sections.heading: Installer and update fixes
items: Android extension support follows your installer choice.

sections.heading: Platform and build fixes
items: Fixed the Mac launch crash.
Releases are verified before shipping.
macOS builds fetch ffmpeg and ffprobe again.
Linux and Flatpak builds provision themselves again.
Windows setup uses the newest mpv.
Extension builds no longer hit Windows' command-line limits.
They work on macOS and BSD too.
Toolchain updates handle new CMake and spaced paths.
Harbor's services now live at harborcommunity.site.

sections.heading: Thanks
items: Thanks to @Thunderhawkk, @Quantumishard, @comet776, @3-pr, @Justsnoopy30 and @jton3.
